question: Who took over as the Director of the Intelligence Bureau on 24 June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tapan Kumar Deka.**__

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Central government on **24 June 2022 appointed senior IPS officer Tapan Kumar Deka as Director of the Intelligence Bureau (IB).**
 
• Deka, a 1988 batch Himachal Pradesh cadre IPS officer, has been appointed for a tenure of two years.
 
• He will succeed incumbent Intelligence Bureau Director Arvind Kumar, whose tenure ends on June 30.
 
• Deka is currently the head of the Operations Desk of the IB.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

**​Important Appointments:**

 
• **The New Development Bank (NDB)** of the BRICS countries has appointed Dr D J Pandian as the Director-General of its India Regional Office in Gujarat International Finance Tec-City (GIFT City).
 
• **Senior Diplomat Ruchira Kamboj **has been appointed as the next Ambassador and Permanent Representative of India to the United Nations.
 
• Somali president Hassan Sheikh Mohamud on 15 June 2022 appointed Hamza Abdi Barre as the country's Prime Minister.
 
• Justice Bhimanagouda Sanganagouda Patil has been appointed as the new Lokayukta of Karnataka.
 
• President Ram Nath Kovind has given Justice Pradip Kumar Mohanty the additional charge of the Lokpal chairperson.​
 
• Dinkar Gupta, a 1987-batch IPS officer and former chief of the Punjab Police, has been appointed Director-General of the National Investigation Agency (NIA).
